benefits.text:
Inspired by the sparkle of raw materials, the MINI version of Raw Glow Gel Tint delivers a plump-looking, glossy lip effect that is transparent like a gemstone. 
1. The Raw-Glow texture gives a fresh lip color that is easy to build up or sheer out and does not oxidize, suitable for all skin tones.
2. The moisturizing formula helps keep lips soft, smooth and plump-looking. 
3. Compact mini design that keeps the same applicator as the full-size version, convenient to carry and use every day.

howToUse.text: Apply directly to the lips. After applying, wait about 10 seconds and try not to press your lips together so the glossy layer forms more clearly. If the product is hard to get out, gently tap the tube against your palm, then rotate the applicator 360° around the inside wall of the container before use.

safety.text:
For external use on the lip area only; do not use on damaged lips,
Stop use if any unusual signs appear and keep out of reach of children.

claimDisclaimers.text: “Plump” is a makeup effect, not actual lip plumping. Do not interpret moisturizing as treating dry/flaky lips.
